Nina V.: Quick sync  we need final redirects + schema snippets for the launch hub and webinar landing. Tiny whitelist only.
Omar R.: Agreed. No regex. 1:1 map only. I'll own the CSV.
Eve H.: Canonical decision? I prefer hub canonical (keeps evergreen traffic) and webinar self-canonical.
Raj K.: Hub-canonical sounds safe. We'll add strong hub->webinar anchors instead of exact-match over-optimization.
Omar R.: Draft redirect CSV (4 rows):
```
/old-signup,/events/2026/fast-inference
/getting-started-llm,/guides/llm-getting-started
/kv-cache-tips,/learn/kv-cache-best-practices
/old-release-notes,/resources/release-2026-05
```
Nina V.: Schema: Event JSON-LD on webinar (startDate ISO UTC + organizer), FAQ on webinar page, BreadcrumbList on hub. Notify SEO bot for preflight.
seo-lint-bot: Preflight: missing Event.startDate on /events/2026/fast-inference, BreadcrumbList absent on /learn/webinar-hub.
Eve H.: I'll add startDate and organizer now. Also will collate 5 FAQ Qs from transcript for FAQ schema.
Raj K.: Anchor plan: two anchor variants, one branded + descriptive, one shorter. Limit identical anchors to 2 pages.
Omar R.: I'll push redirects to seo/redirects_may2026.csv and request deploy Friday. Will add a unit test to ensure no redirect loops.
Nina V.: Owners: redirects = Omar, schema/FAQ = Eve, canonical + monitoring = Raj, rollout timing = Nina. Target publish Tue 09:00 PT if preflight green.
Eve H.: Dropping FAQ draft in doc by EOD.
Nina V.: Thanks team  I'll run a post-publish check and create a follow-up thread for Search Console findings.
